buyers_guide.q: Smart power strip or several smart plugs?
buyers_guide.a: A strip puts three to six individually controlled outlets, and usually USB ports, in one place, which suits a desk or entertainment center. Smart plugs suit single lamps spread around the house.

buyers_guide.q: Does a smart power strip protect against surges?
buyers_guide.a: Only if the listing gives a joule rating. Many smart strips have surge protection, but some don't; check before plugging in a computer or TV.

buyers_guide.q: Can each outlet be controlled separately?
buyers_guide.a: On most smart strips, yes: each outlet appears as its own switch in the app and in Alexa or Google. USB ports are usually switched together.
